subject: Re: how to assign different colors according to a factor and at the same time specify which color?

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: how to assign different colors according to a factor and at the same time specify which color?
parts:
Here's a simple example using a 12-level factor:

# select 12 colors from the rainbow palette, equally spaced
# along the color gradient
cols <- rainbow(12)

# Notice that f is a 12-level factor
DF <- data.frame(f = factor(rep(LETTERS[1:12], each = 10)),
y = rnorm(120))

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(DF, aes(x = f, y = y, color = f)) +
geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.1)) +
scale_color_manual(values = cols)

If you can't see how this pertains to your actual problem, please
consult the link at the bottom of this message and provide a
reproducible example that is more in line with your actual problem.

Dennis
